replacements.old:
"ZORK1 MARA FIELD CAPABILITY DISCOVERY GLULX for
  Zork I: The Great Underground Empire
  (c) Copyright 1983 Infocom, Inc. All Rights Reserved."

;"Repository-local Mara Field Capability Discovery. Release 1259 lets Mara's
  existing survey knowledge become capability biography through bodily recovery,
  an authored River Frigid pendulum traversal, deliberate movement reuse, and
  acoustic ranging that she first discovers and later intentionally repeats.
  No XP, perks, generic skill engine, traversal AI, or puzzle-solving companion."
replacements.new:
"ZORK1 MARA LIVED FEELING RUPTURE AND REPAIR GLULX for
  Zork I: The Great Underground Empire
  (c) Copyright 1983 Infocom, Inc. All Rights Reserved."

;"Repository-local Mara Lived Feeling, Rupture & Repair. Release 1260 lets
  specific events acquire authored personal meaning: chosen recklessness can
  produce concerned anger, intentional violence creates remembered betrayal and
  physical distance, and later concrete behavior can earn renewed cooperation
  without deleting the event that required repair. No generic emotion engine."
